subject: residual variance estimation in logit link

messages.author: 07fea40b80effbb0
messages.subject: residual variance estimation in logit link
parts:
Hello all,

I want to build a factor analysis model using Bayesian MCMC in OpenBugs. It is a nonlinear CFA model, so I cannot use the Blavaan package. The link function I use the logit. When building the model, I found that logit link has no error terms. So I wonder how should I estimate the residual variance in this case. 

Traditionally the error variance for logit link is fixed to pi^2/3.However, I remember that when I used Lavaan package with MLR or WLSMV estimators, Lavaan was able to provide different residual variances for different items, not a fixed value. Thus, I want to ask how to estimate the the residual variance for logit link?

Thank you for help.

Carol

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: residual variance estimation in logit link
parts:
Carol

If you defined it from the SEM perspective, first need to defined the undelrying latent variable that relates to the binary/categorical items, this way the "error" term is related to this factor
Its a work in progress, and we are expecting to add this to blavaan (hopefully in the near future)

If you defined it from the IRT parameterrization, there is thecnically no residual, but the  logistic parameters.

You can see how I have written some IRT models in Stan in my github https://github.com/maugavilla/IRTStan
